subject: fix(ci): validate sd-cpp auto-updates and flag failed checks (#3975)
summary: Reworks the sd-cpp auto-update workflow to run API documentation verification before staging docs in the update PR, serialize concurrent update PRs per release pair, add a three-way conflict-safe replay for generated API documentation, and surface any incomplete backend or GPU-offload validation as a [Validation failed] draft PR with a detailed warning body.
verdict_reason: The PR adds substantial new logic to a scheduled workflow that auto-creates and manages bot PRs; two commits were pushed after approval (a missing-index fix and a conflict-safe replay refactor) and the end-to-end scheduled/dispatch path has not been tested.
